<?php
if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
	exit;
}

final class AC_WPTB_REST {
	private const NS = 'agadir-concept-test-bridge/v1';

	public static function init(): void {
		add_action( 'rest_api_init', array( __CLASS__, 'routes' ) );
	}

	public static function routes(): void {
		register_rest_route(
			self::NS,
			'/remote',
			array(
				'methods'             => WP_REST_Server::READABLE,
				'callback'            => array( __CLASS__, 'remote_control' ),
				'permission_callback' => '__return_true',
			)
		);
		register_rest_route(
			self::NS,
			'/status',
			array(
				'methods'             => WP_REST_Server::READABLE,
				'callback'            => array( __CLASS__, 'status' ),
				'permission_callback' => '__return_true',
			)
		);

		$read_routes = array(
			'/snapshot'       => 'snapshot',
			'/pages'          => 'pages',
			'/menus'          => 'menus',
			'/errors'         => 'errors',
			'/scan'           => 'scan',
			'/audit'          => 'audit',
			'/elementor'      => 'elementor',
			'/page-audit'     => 'page_audit',
			'/file'           => 'file_read',
			'/frontend'       => 'frontend',
			'/widgets'        => 'widgets',
			'/doctor'         => 'doctor',
			'/runtime-errors' => 'runtime_errors',
			'/capabilities'   => 'capabilities',
			'/full/capabilities' => 'full_capabilities',
			'/full/read'         => 'full_read',
		);
		foreach ( $read_routes as $route => $callback ) {
			register_rest_route(
				self::NS,
				$route,
				array(
					'methods'             => WP_REST_Server::READABLE,
					'callback'            => array( __CLASS__, $callback ),
					'permission_callback' => static fn( WP_REST_Request $request ) => AC_WPTB_Core::verify_signed_request( $request, false ),
				)
			);
		}

		$write_routes = array(
			'/patch/init'      => 'patch_init',
			'/patch/chunk'     => 'patch_chunk',
			'/patch/commit'    => 'patch_commit',
			'/rollback'        => 'rollback',
			'/cache/clear'     => 'cache_clear',
			'/plugin/activate' => 'plugin_activate',
			'/plugin/deactivate' => 'plugin_deactivate',
			'/upload/init'       => 'upload_init',
			'/upload/chunk'      => 'upload_chunk',
			'/upload/commit'     => 'upload_commit',
			'/plugin/package-rollback' => 'plugin_package_rollback',
			'/elementor/template-apply' => 'elementor_template_apply',
			'/capture'           => 'capture',
			'/full/write'        => 'full_write',
		);
		foreach ( $write_routes as $route => $callback ) {
			register_rest_route(
				self::NS,
				$route,
				array(
					'methods'             => WP_REST_Server::READABLE,
					'callback'            => array( __CLASS__, $callback ),
					'permission_callback' => static fn( WP_REST_Request $request ) => AC_WPTB_Core::verify_signed_request( $request, true ),
				)
			);
		}
	}

	public static function remote_control( WP_REST_Request $request ) {
		$action = sanitize_key( (string) $request->get_param( 'action' ) );
		if ( '' === $action ) {
			$verified = AC_WPTB_Core::verify_remote_control( $request, false );
			if ( is_wp_error( $verified ) ) {
				return $verified;
			}

			// A bare remote request must be read-only. Previous versions executed
			// the legacy page autopilot and cleared caches implicitly, which made
			// diagnostics stateful and produced stale warnings after page rebuilds.
			AC_WPTB_Core::audit( 'remote_status' );
			return self::status();
		}

		$read_actions = array(
			'doctor'         => 'doctor',
			'runtime-errors' => 'runtime_errors',
			'snapshot'       => 'snapshot',
			'pages'          => 'pages',
			'widgets'        => 'widgets',
			'menus'          => 'menus',
			'scan'           => 'scan',
			'audit'          => 'audit',
			'elementor'      => 'elementor',
			'page-audit'     => 'page_audit',
			'file-read'      => 'file_read',
			'frontend'       => 'frontend',
			'capabilities'     => 'capabilities',
			'full-capabilities' => 'full_capabilities',
			'full-read'         => 'full_read',
		);
		$write_actions = array(
			'patch-init'       => array( 'callback' => 'patch_init', 'confirm' => 'PATCH' ),
			'patch-chunk'      => array( 'callback' => 'patch_chunk', 'confirm' => 'PATCH' ),
			'patch-commit'     => array( 'callback' => 'patch_commit', 'confirm' => 'PATCH' ),
			'rollback'         => array( 'callback' => 'rollback', 'confirm' => 'ROLLBACK' ),
			'cache-clear'      => array( 'callback' => 'cache_clear', 'confirm' => 'CLEAR' ),
			'plugin-activate'  => array( 'callback' => 'plugin_activate', 'confirm' => 'ACTIVATE' ),
			'plugin-deactivate'=> array( 'callback' => 'plugin_deactivate', 'confirm' => 'DEACTIVATE' ),
			'upload-init'      => array( 'callback' => 'upload_init', 'confirm' => 'UPLOAD' ),
			'upload-chunk'     => array( 'callback' => 'upload_chunk', 'confirm' => 'UPLOAD' ),
			'upload-commit'    => array( 'callback' => 'upload_commit', 'confirm' => 'UPLOAD' ),
			'plugin-package-rollback' => array( 'callback' => 'plugin_package_rollback', 'confirm' => 'ROLLBACK' ),
			'elementor-template-apply' => array( 'callback' => 'elementor_template_apply', 'confirm' => 'APPLY' ),
			'capture'          => array( 'callback' => 'capture', 'confirm' => 'CAPTURE' ),
			'full-write'       => array( 'callback' => 'full_write', 'confirm' => 'FULL' ),
		);

		if ( isset( $read_actions[ $action ] ) ) {
			$verified = AC_WPTB_Core::verify_remote_control( $request, false );
			if ( is_wp_error( $verified ) ) {
				return $verified;
			}
			AC_WPTB_Core::audit( 'remote_' . str_replace( '-', '_', $action ) );
			return call_user_func( array( __CLASS__, $read_actions[ $action ] ), $request );
		}
		if ( isset( $write_actions[ $action ] ) ) {
			$config   = $write_actions[ $action ];
			$verified = AC_WPTB_Core::verify_remote_control( $request, true, $config['confirm'] );
			if ( is_wp_error( $verified ) ) {
				return $verified;
			}
			AC_WPTB_Core::audit( 'remote_' . str_replace( '-', '_', $action ), array( 'remote_fingerprint' => AC_WPTB_Core::remote_fingerprint() ) );
			return call_user_func( array( __CLASS__, $config['callback'] ), $request );
		}
		return new WP_Error( 'ac_remote_action', 'Unknown or disallowed remote action.', array( 'status' => 400 ) );
	}


	private static function autopilot( WP_REST_Request $request ): WP_REST_Response {
		$doctor_before = AC_WPTB_Doctor::report();
		$warnings      = array();
		$checks        = array();
		$changes       = array();

		$target_path = self::sanitize_page_path( (string) $request->get_param( 'target' ) );
		if ( '' === $target_path ) {
			$target_path = 'sites-web-professionnels/site-vitrine';
		}
		$target = get_page_by_path( $target_path, OBJECT, 'page' );
		if ( ! $target instanceof WP_Post ) {
			$warnings[] = 'La page cible est introuvable.';
		} else {
			$page_request = new WP_REST_Request( 'GET', '/' );
			$page_request->set_param( 'post_id', (int) $target->ID );
			$page_audit_response = self::page_audit( $page_request );
			if ( is_wp_error( $page_audit_response ) ) {
				$warnings[] = $page_audit_response->get_error_message();
			} else {
				$page_audit = $page_audit_response->get_data();
				$checks['page_audit'] = $page_audit;
				if ( empty( $page_audit['valid_json'] ) ) {
					$warnings[] = 'Le document Elementor de la page cible n’est pas un JSON valide.';
				}
				if ( 1 !== (int) ( $page_audit['frontend_h1_count'] ?? 0 ) ) {
					$warnings[] = 'Le frontend de la page cible ne contient pas exactement un H1.';
				}
				if ( ! empty( $page_audit['duplicate_ids'] ) ) {
					$warnings[] = 'Des identifiants Elementor dupliqués sont présents sur la page cible.';
				}
				if ( ! empty( $page_audit['unknown_widgets'] ) ) {
					$warnings[] = 'Des widgets Elementor inconnus sont présents sur la page cible.';
				}
				if ( 0 !== (int) ( $page_audit['empty_or_hash_links'] ?? 0 ) ) {
					$warnings[] = 'Des liens vides ou limités à # sont présents sur la page cible.';
				}
			}

			$path = (string) wp_parse_url( get_permalink( $target->ID ), PHP_URL_PATH );
			$frontend = self::fetch_frontend_path( $path ?: '/' );
			if ( is_wp_error( $frontend ) ) {
				$warnings[] = 'Le frontend de la page cible n’a pas pu être chargé : ' . AC_WPTB_Core::redact( $frontend->get_error_message() );
			} else {
				$checks['frontend'] = self::frontend_metrics( $frontend );
				if ( 200 !== (int) ( $frontend['status'] ?? 0 ) ) {
					$warnings[] = 'Le frontend de la page cible ne répond pas en HTTP 200.';
				}
			}
		}

		$parent = get_page_by_path( 'sites-web-professionnels', OBJECT, 'page' );
		if ( $parent instanceof WP_Post ) {
			$parent_data = (string) get_post_meta( $parent->ID, '_elementor_data', true );
			$checks['protected_parent'] = array(
				'post_id' => (int) $parent->ID,
				'slug'    => $parent->post_name,
				'sha256'  => hash( 'sha256', $parent_data ),
			);
		}

		$target_slug = $target instanceof WP_Post ? sanitize_key( $target->post_name ) : sanitize_key( basename( $target_path ) );
		$target_plugin_file = 'ac-' . $target_slug . '-page/ac-' . $target_slug . '-page.php';
		$checks['target_page_plugin'] = self::plugin_summary( $target_plugin_file );
		$checks['dependencies'] = array(
			'ac_sites_web_page' => self::plugin_summary( 'ac-sites-web-page/ac-sites-web-page.php' ),
			'ac_widgets'        => self::find_plugin_by_directory( 'agadir-concept-elementor-widgets-0.1.0' ),
		);

		wp_cache_flush();
		$changes[] = array( 'action' => 'wp-cache-flush', 'scope' => 'object-cache' );
		if ( class_exists( '\Elementor\Plugin' ) && isset( \Elementor\Plugin::$instance->files_manager ) ) {
			try {
				\Elementor\Plugin::$instance->files_manager->clear_cache();
				$changes[] = array( 'action' => 'elementor-cache-clear', 'scope' => 'generated-files' );
			} catch ( Throwable $e ) {
				$warnings[] = 'Cache Elementor : ' . AC_WPTB_Core::redact( $e->getMessage() );
			}
		}

		$runtime      = self::runtime_errors_data();
		$doctor_after = AC_WPTB_Doctor::report();
		if ( ! empty( $runtime['count'] ) ) {
			$warnings[] = 'Le Runtime Probe contient des erreurs.';
		}

		return rest_ensure_response(
			array(
				'ok'             => empty( $warnings ),
				'mode'           => 'autopilot-page',
				'target'         => $target_path,
				'checks'         => $checks,
				'changes'        => $changes,
				'warnings'       => $warnings,
				'runtime_errors' => $runtime,
				'doctor_before'  => $doctor_before,
				'doctor_after'   => $doctor_after,
				'audit_tail'     => array_slice( AC_WPTB_Core::audit_log(), -8 ),
			)
		);
	}

	private static function plugin_summary( string $plugin_file ): array {
		require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/plugin.php';
		$plugin_file = plugin_basename( $plugin_file );
		$path        = WP_PLUGIN_DIR . '/' . $plugin_file;
		if ( ! is_file( $path ) ) {
			return array( 'file' => $plugin_file, 'installed' => false, 'active' => false, 'version' => '' );
		}
		$data = get_plugin_data( $path, false, false );
		return array(
			'file'      => $plugin_file,
			'installed' => true,
			'active'    => is_plugin_active( $plugin_file ),
			'version'   => (string) ( $data['Version'] ?? '' ),
		);
	}

	private static function find_plugin_by_directory( string $directory ): array {
		require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/plugin.php';
		foreach ( get_plugins( '/' . $directory ) as $file => $data ) {
			$plugin_file = $directory . '/' . $file;
			return array(
				'file'      => $plugin_file,
				'installed' => true,
				'active'    => is_plugin_active( $plugin_file ),
				'version'   => (string) ( $data['Version'] ?? '' ),
			);
		}
		return array( 'file' => $directory, 'installed' => false, 'active' => false, 'version' => '' );
	}

	public static function status(): WP_REST_Response {
		return rest_ensure_response(
			array(
				'version'              => AC_WPTB_VERSION,
				'active'               => AC_WPTB_Core::is_enabled(),
				'expires_at'           => AC_WPTB_Core::enabled_until() ? gmdate( 'c', AC_WPTB_Core::enabled_until() ) : null,
				'fingerprint'          => AC_WPTB_Core::fingerprint(),
				'namespace'            => self::NS,
				'full_control'         => AC_WPTB_Full_Control::is_enabled(),
				'full_control_expires' => AC_WPTB_Full_Control::enabled_until() ? gmdate( 'c', AC_WPTB_Full_Control::enabled_until() ) : null,
				'jobs'                 => AC_WPTB_Jobs::status()['last'] ?? array(),
				'runtime_error_count'  => count( AC_WPTB_Runtime::errors() ),
			)
		);
	}

	public static function snapshot(): WP_REST_Response {
		require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/plugin.php';
		$theme          = wp_get_theme();
		$active_plugins = array();
		foreach ( (array) get_option( 'active_plugins', array() ) as $plugin_file ) {
			$path = WP_PLUGIN_DIR . '/' . $plugin_file;
			$data = is_file( $path ) ? get_plugin_data( $path, false, false ) : array();
			$active_plugins[] = array(
				'file'    => $plugin_file,
				'name'    => $data['Name'] ?? $plugin_file,
				'version' => $data['Version'] ?? '',
			);
		}
		global $wpdb;
		return rest_ensure_response(
			array(
				'wordpress' => array(
					'version'       => get_bloginfo( 'version' ),
					'site_url'      => site_url(),
					'home_url'      => home_url(),
					'permalink'     => get_option( 'permalink_structure' ),
					'language'      => get_bloginfo( 'language' ),
					'multisite'     => is_multisite(),
					'wp_debug'      => defined( 'WP_DEBUG' ) && WP_DEBUG,
					'wp_debug_log'  => defined( 'WP_DEBUG_LOG' ) ? WP_DEBUG_LOG : false,
				),
				'php' => array(
					'version'       => PHP_VERSION,
					'memory_limit'  => ini_get( 'memory_limit' ),
					'max_execution' => ini_get( 'max_execution_time' ),
					'upload_max'    => ini_get( 'upload_max_filesize' ),
				),
				'database' => array(
					'server'  => $wpdb->db_version(),
					'charset' => $wpdb->charset,
				),
				'theme' => array(
					'name'    => $theme->get( 'Name' ),
					'version' => $theme->get( 'Version' ),
					'slug'    => $theme->get_stylesheet(),
				),
				'plugins' => $active_plugins,
				'elementor' => array(
					'active'      => defined( 'ELEMENTOR_VERSION' ),
					'version'     => defined( 'ELEMENTOR_VERSION' ) ? ELEMENTOR_VERSION : null,
					'pro_active'  => defined( 'ELEMENTOR_PRO_VERSION' ),
					'pro_version' => defined( 'ELEMENTOR_PRO_VERSION' ) ? ELEMENTOR_PRO_VERSION : null,
				),
				'agadir_concept' => array(
					'front_page_id'      => (int) get_option( 'page_on_front' ),
					'posts_page_id'      => (int) get_option( 'page_for_posts' ),
					'bridge_write_roots' => AC_WPTB_Core::scan_roots(),
				),
			)
		);
	}

	public static function pages(): WP_REST_Response {
		$posts = get_posts( array( 'post_type' => array( 'page', 'elementor_library' ), 'post_status' => array( 'publish', 'draft', 'private', 'pending' ), 'posts_per_page' => 300, 'orderby' => 'post_type title', 'order' => 'ASC' ) );
		$rows = array();
		foreach ( $posts as $post ) {
			$rows[] = array(
				'id'          => (int) $post->ID,
				'type'        => $post->post_type,
				'status'      => $post->post_status,
				'title'       => get_the_title( $post ),
				'slug'        => $post->post_name,
				'parent'      => (int) $post->post_parent,
				'template'    => get_page_template_slug( $post ),
				'elementor'   => (string) get_post_meta( $post->ID, '_elementor_edit_mode', true ),
				'elements'    => strlen( (string) get_post_meta( $post->ID, '_elementor_data', true ) ),
				'modified'    => get_post_modified_time( 'c', true, $post ),
			);
		}
		return rest_ensure_response( array( 'count' => count( $rows ), 'items' => $rows ) );
	}

	public static function menus(): WP_REST_Response {
		$menus = array();
		foreach ( wp_get_nav_menus() as $menu ) {
			$items = array();
			foreach ( wp_get_nav_menu_items( $menu->term_id ) ?: array() as $item ) {
				$items[] = array( 'id' => (int) $item->ID, 'title' => $item->title, 'url' => $item->url, 'parent' => (int) $item->menu_item_parent, 'order' => (int) $item->menu_order, 'type' => $item->type, 'object' => $item->object, 'object_id' => (int) $item->object_id );
			}
			$menus[] = array( 'id' => (int) $menu->term_id, 'name' => $menu->name, 'slug' => $menu->slug, 'items' => $items );
		}
		return rest_ensure_response( array( 'locations' => get_nav_menu_locations(), 'menus' => $menus ) );
	}

	public static function errors(): WP_REST_Response {
		$file = self::debug_log_path();
		if ( ! $file || ! is_readable( $file ) ) {
			return rest_ensure_response( array( 'path' => null, 'lines' => array() ) );
		}
		$lines = file( $file, FILE_IGNORE_NEW_LINES | FILE_SKIP_EMPTY_LINES ); // phpcs:ignore WordPress.WP.AlternativeFunctions.file_system_operations_file
		$lines = is_array( $lines ) ? array_slice( $lines, -100 ) : array();
		return rest_ensure_response( array( 'path' => basename( $file ), 'lines' => array_map( array( 'AC_WPTB_Core', 'redact' ), $lines ) ) );
	}

	public static function scan(): WP_REST_Response { return rest_ensure_response( AC_WPTB_Core::scan() ); }
	public static function audit(): WP_REST_Response { return rest_ensure_response( array( 'items' => AC_WPTB_Core::audit_log() ) ); }
	public static function page_audit( WP_REST_Request $request ) {
		$post_id = absint( $request->get_param( 'post_id' ) );
		if ( ! $post_id ) {
			return new WP_Error( 'ac_page_id', 'A valid post_id is required.', array( 'status' => 400 ) );
		}
		$post = get_post( $post_id );
		if ( ! $post instanceof WP_Post ) {
			return new WP_Error( 'ac_page_missing', 'Post not found.', array( 'status' => 404 ) );
		}

		$json    = (string) get_post_meta( $post_id, '_elementor_data', true );
		$data    = json_decode( $json, true );
		$metrics = self::elementor_metrics( is_array( $data ) ? $data : array() );
		$metrics['post_id']       = $post_id;
		$metrics['title']         = get_the_title( $post );
		$metrics['slug']          = $post->post_name;
		$metrics['valid_json']    = is_array( $data );
		$metrics['json_sha256']   = hash( 'sha256', $json );

		$permalink = get_permalink( $post_id );
		$path      = $permalink ? (string) wp_parse_url( $permalink, PHP_URL_PATH ) : '';
		$frontend  = '' !== $path ? self::fetch_frontend_path( $path ) : new WP_Error( 'ac_page_url', 'Page URL unavailable.' );
		if ( is_wp_error( $frontend ) ) {
			$metrics['frontend_error'] = $frontend->get_error_message();
			$metrics['frontend_status'] = null;
			$metrics['frontend_h1_count'] = null;
		} else {
			$metrics['frontend_status'] = $frontend['status'];
			$metrics['frontend_h1_count'] = substr_count( strtolower( (string) $frontend['body'] ), '<h1' );
		}
		return rest_ensure_response( $metrics );
	}

	public static function elementor(): WP_REST_Response {
		$data = array( 'custom_widgets' => array(), 'theme_builder' => array() );
		if ( class_exists( '\Elementor\Plugin' ) ) {
			$manager = \Elementor\Plugin::instance()->widgets_manager;
			foreach ( $manager->get_widget_types() as $widget ) {
				$name = $widget->get_name();
				if ( str_starts_with( $name, 'ac' ) || str_contains( strtolower( $widget->get_title() ), 'agadir' ) ) {
					$data['custom_widgets'][] = array( 'name' => $name, 'title' => $widget->get_title(), 'categories' => $widget->get_categories() );
				}
			}
		}
		$query = new WP_Query(
			array(
				'post_type'      => 'elementor_library',
				'post_status'    => array( 'publish', 'draft', 'private' ),
				'posts_per_page' => 200,
				'orderby'        => 'ID',
				'order'          => 'ASC',
			)
		);
		foreach ( $query->posts as $post ) {
			$type = (string) get_post_meta( $post->ID, '_elementor_template_type', true );
			if ( ! in_array( $type, array( 'header', 'footer', 'single', 'archive', 'page', 'section', 'container' ), true ) ) {
				continue;
			}
			$data['theme_builder'][] = array(
				'id'         => (int) $post->ID,
				'title'      => get_the_title( $post ),
				'type'       => $type,
				'status'     => $post->post_status,
				'conditions' => get_post_meta( $post->ID, '_elementor_conditions', true ),
				'modified'   => get_post_modified_time( 'c', true, $post ),
			);
		}
		usort( $data['custom_widgets'], static fn( array $a, array $b ): int => strcmp( $a['name'], $b['name'] ) );
		return rest_ensure_response( $data );
	}

	public static function doctor(): WP_REST_Response {
		return rest_ensure_response( AC_WPTB_Doctor::report() );
	}

	private static function runtime_errors_data(): array {
		$items = AC_WPTB_Runtime::errors();
		return array( 'count' => count( $items ), 'items' => $items );
	}

	public static function runtime_errors(): WP_REST_Response {
		return rest_ensure_response( self::runtime_errors_data() );
	}

	public static function file_read( WP_REST_Request $request ) {
		$relative = sanitize_text_field( (string) $request->get_param( 'path' ) );
		$resolved = AC_WPTB_Core::allowed_file_target( $relative );
		if ( is_wp_error( $resolved ) ) {
			return $resolved;
		}
		if ( ! is_file( $resolved ) || ! is_readable( $resolved ) ) {
			return new WP_Error( 'ac_file_missing', 'Requested file is not readable.', array( 'status' => 404 ) );
		}
		$size = filesize( $resolved );
		if ( false === $size || $size > 524288 ) {
			return new WP_Error( 'ac_file_size', 'File is larger than the 512 KB bridge read limit.', array( 'status' => 413 ) );
		}
		$content = (string) file_get_contents( $resolved ); // phpcs:ignore WordPress.WP.AlternativeFunctions.file_get_contents_file_get_contents
		return rest_ensure_response( array( 'path' => $relative, 'size' => $size, 'sha256' => hash( 'sha256', $content ), 'content' => AC_WPTB_Core::redact( $content ) ) );
	}

	public static function frontend( WP_REST_Request $request ) {
		$path   = (string) $request->get_param( 'path' );

		return is_wp_error( $result ) ? $result : rest_ensure_response( $result );

	private static function fetch_frontend_path( string $path ) {
		$path = '/' . ltrim( $path, '/' );
		$url  = home_url( $path );
		$home = wp_parse_url( home_url() );
		$test = wp_parse_url( $url );
		if ( empty( $home['host'] ) || empty( $test['host'] ) || strtolower( $home['host'] ) !== strtolower( $test['host'] ) ) {
			return new WP_Error( 'ac_frontend_host', 'Only same-site frontend paths can be fetched.', array( 'status' => 400 ) );
		}
		$response = wp_remote_get(
			$url,
			array(
				'timeout'     => 20,
				'redirection' => 2,
				'headers'     => array( 'Cache-Control' => 'no-cache', 'User-Agent' => 'Agadir-Concept-WP-Test-Bridge/' . AC_WPTB_VERSION ),
			)
		);
		if ( is_wp_error( $response ) ) { return $response; }
		return array(
			'status'  => (int) wp_remote_retrieve_response_code( $response ),
			'headers' => array(
				'content_type' => wp_remote_retrieve_header( $response, 'content-type' ),
				'cache_control'=> wp_remote_retrieve_header( $response, 'cache-control' ),
			),
			'body'    => substr( (string) wp_remote_retrieve_body( $response ), 0, 200000 ),
		);
	}

	private static function frontend_metrics( array $frontend ): array {
		$body = (string) ( $frontend['body'] ?? '' );
		return array(
			'status'       => (int) ( $frontend['status'] ?? 0 ),
			'h1_count'     => substr_count( strtolower( $body ), '<h1' ),
			'body_bytes'   => strlen( $body ),
			'has_html'     => str_contains( strtolower( $body ), '<html' ),
			'has_elementor'=> str_contains( $body, 'elementor' ),
		);
	}

	private static function decode_payload( string $raw ) {
		if ( '' === $raw ) { return array(); }
		if ( strlen( $raw ) > 4_194_304 ) { return new WP_Error( 'ac_payload_size', 'Payload too large.', array( 'status' => 413 ) ); }
		$decoded = base64_decode( strtr( $raw, '-_', '+/' ), true );
		if ( false === $decoded ) { return new WP_Error( 'ac_payload_encoding', 'Payload must be URL-safe base64 JSON.', array( 'status' => 400 ) ); }
		$data = json_decode( $decoded, true );
		return is_array( $data ) ? $data : new WP_Error( 'ac_payload_json', 'Payload JSON is invalid.', array( 'status' => 400 ) );
	}

		$post_id    = absint( $request->get_param( 'post_id' ) );

		if ( ! $post_id || ! $plugin_dir || ! AC_WPTB_Core::allowed_plugin_directory( $plugin_dir ) ) { return new WP_Error( 'ac_elementor_apply', 'post_id and allowed plugin_dir are required.', array( 'status' => 400 ) ); }
		$result = apply_filters( 'agadir_concept_bridge_apply_page_package', null, $plugin_dir, array( 'post_id' => $post_id ) );
		if ( null === $result ) { return new WP_Error( 'ac_elementor_hook', 'Target plugin did not expose an Elementor apply hook.', array( 'status' => 400 ) ); }
		return is_wp_error( $result ) ? $result : rest_ensure_response( $result );
	}

	private static function sanitize_page_path( string $path ): string {
		$path = trim( str_replace( '\\', '/', $path ), '/' );
		if ( '' === $path ) { return ''; }
		$segments = array_filter( array_map( 'sanitize_title', explode( '/', $path ) ) );
		return implode( '/', $segments );
	}

	private static function collect_file_names( array $payload ): array {
		$names = array();
		$iterator = static function ( $value ) use ( &$iterator, &$names ): void {
			if ( is_array( $value ) ) { foreach ( $value as $child ) { $iterator( $child ); } return; }
			if ( is_string( $value ) && preg_match_all( '/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\.(?:php|css|js|json)/i', $value, $matches ) ) { foreach ( $matches[0] as $match ) { $names[] = $match; } }
		};
		$iterator( $payload );
		return array_values( array_unique( $names ) );
	}

	private static function extract_widget_names( string $content ): array {
		$names = array();
		if ( preg_match_all( '/get_name\s*\(\s*\)\s*:\s*string\s*\{\s*return\s+[\"\']([^\"\']+)/', $content, $matches ) ) { $names = array_merge( $names, $matches[1] ); }
		if ( preg_match_all( '/get_name\s*\(\s*\)[^{]*\{\s*return\s+[\"\']([^\"\']+)/', $content, $matches ) ) { $names = array_merge( $names, $matches[1] ); }
		return array_values( array_unique( array_map( 'sanitize_key', $names ) ) );
	}

	private static function elementor_metrics( array $data ): array {
		$ids = array(); $widgets = array(); $links = array(); $html_widgets = 0; $text_widgets = 0; $shortcode_widgets = 0;
		$walker = static function ( $node ) use ( &$walker, &$ids, &$widgets, &$links, &$html_widgets, &$text_widgets, &$shortcode_widgets ): void {
			if ( ! is_array( $node ) ) { return; }
			if ( isset( $node['id'] ) ) { $ids[] = (string) $node['id']; }
			if ( isset( $node['widgetType'] ) ) {
				$type = (string) $node['widgetType']; $widgets[] = $type;
				if ( 'html' === $type ) { ++$html_widgets; } elseif ( 'text-editor' === $type ) { ++$text_widgets; } elseif ( 'shortcode' === $type ) { ++$shortcode_widgets; }
			}
			foreach ( $node as $key => $value ) {
				if ( is_string( $value ) && ( str_contains( (string) $key, 'url' ) || str_contains( (string) $key, 'link' ) ) ) { $links[] = $value; }
				if ( is_array( $value ) ) { $walker( $value ); }
			}
		};
		$walker( $data );
		$counts = array_count_values( $ids );
		$duplicates = array_keys( array_filter( $counts, static fn( int $count ): bool => $count > 1 ) );
		$registered = array();
		if ( class_exists( '\Elementor\Plugin' ) ) { $registered = array_keys( \Elementor\Plugin::instance()->widgets_manager->get_widget_types() ); }
		return array(
			'element_count'        => count( $ids ),
			'widget_count'         => count( $widgets ),
			'widget_types'         => array_values( array_count_values( $widgets ) ),
			'duplicate_ids'        => $duplicates,
			'unknown_widgets'      => array_values( array_diff( array_unique( $widgets ), $registered ) ),
			'html_widgets'         => $html_widgets,
			'text_editor_widgets'  => $text_widgets,
			'shortcode_widgets'    => $shortcode_widgets,
			'empty_or_hash_links'  => count( array_filter( $links, static fn( string $link ): bool => '' === trim( $link ) || '#' === trim( $link ) ) ),
		);
	}
